_about: The SOURCE book's own author/editor notes -- a SECOND note stream, kept strictly separate from the translator's notes (notes.json) so the two are never conflated. Shape: {unit_id: [{anchor, n, note}]}. 'n' preserves the author's OWN numbering as printed in the original edition (the builder does not renumber this stream; translator notes get the running count). 'anchor' must be a verbatim substring of the English prose of that unit's out/<id>_reading.md; the build REFUSES (exit 2) on an anchor that never matches. 'note' is the source note rendered into English as XHTML: <i> for emphasis and NUMERIC character references only ( , —), never named entities. Markers render as bracketed teal superscripts, distinct from the translator's plain red numbers, and resolve to the 'Notes in the Original Edition' section of the Notes page. Keys starting with '_' are ignored. When this file is empty or absent the build output is unchanged.
